_comment: PLACEHOLDER COVERS TRIMMED 2026-08-06: this fixture also named maxwell::0, which vector_lagrange_cannot_carry_the_normal_jump owns. The two claims ask for different observables and each fixture measures its own: magnetostatics::2 is about the discrete curl-curl SPECTRUM being wrong (this fixture compares eigenvalues against lambda/pi^2 = 1,1,2,4,4,5,5), while maxwell::0 is about the post-processed B field carrying spurious normal jumps and the error refusing to fall below a few per cent. Crediting one claim to two fixtures counts it twice and leaves the other looking uncovered.
